rationale: Salesforce Workbench outages are a well-documented, recurring pain affecting entire teams simultaneously in paid enterprise contexts. Multiple Stack Exchange threads, Reddit posts, and community discussions confirm the problem is chronic and not isolated. Willingness-to-pay is strongly implied by existing comparable tools (Dataloader.io at $99+/mo, Validity DemandTools at $200+/mo) and by the fact that every affected user is already paying $150–$300/user/month for Salesforce itself.
